author: Ari Koslow
title: Yandy Diaz suffers shoulder injury Sunday
desc: Yandy Diaz left Sunday's game with a left shoulder strain.
impact: Diaz will continue to be further evaluated into Monday. He is considered day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Casey Schmitt (illness) scratched from lineup Sunday
desc: Casey Schmitt was a late scratch from the Giants lineup on Sunday due to an illness.
impact: Schmitt is day-to-day with an illness.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Beck activated from IL, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Rockies activated OF Jordan Beck from the 10-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Beck concluded his rehab assignment. He will remain in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Greene (elbow) deals in rehab start Sunday
desc: Hunter Greene threw 82 pitches over 6 1/3 scoreless innings in a rehab start on Sunday.
impact: Greene allowed just one hit. He should be back in the Reds rotation next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Madrigal signs minor league deal with Rays
desc: The Rays signed Nick Madrigal to a minor league contract.
impact: Madrigal recently elected free agency. He will add infield depth in the Rays organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yosver Zulueta claimed off waivers by Orioles
desc: The Orioles claimed RHP Yosver Zulueta off waivers from the Cubs.
impact: Zulueta was designated for assignment earlier this week. He was optioned to Triple-A by Baltimore.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Framber Valdez hit hard in no-decision
desc: Framber Valdez allowed four earned runs on eight hits while striking out two over six innings in Saturday's 8-6 loss to the Astros.
impact: Valdez has provided mixed results on the mound of late, allowing more than three earned in runs in four of his last eight contests. The left-hander has fought inconsistent command for much of the season for manager AJ Hinch, posting a 4.05 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with a 4-5 record and 7.3 K/9 ratio through 17 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Dylan Cease labors on mound in loss to Rangers
desc: Dylan Cease allowed four earned runs on four hits and five walks while striking out 10 over 4 2/3 innings in Saturday's loss to the Rangers.
impact: Cease continues a solid stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in four of his last five trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more stable arms in an inconsistent Blue Jays rotation to this point, carrying a 3.02 ERA and 1.24 WHIP with a 4-4 record and 13.8 K/9 ratio through 15 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Chase Burns offers mixed results in no-decision
desc: Chase Burns allowed five earned runs on nine hits while striking out 10 over six innings in Saturday's win over the Pirates.
impact: Burns continues a strong stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in 12 of his last 13 trips to the mound. The right-hander has rewarded manager Terry Francona with one of the more impactful starting options in the Reds rotation to this point, carrying a 2.36 ERA and 1.08 WHIP to go with a 9-1 record and 11.0 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Eugenio Suarez goes yard in win over Pirates
desc: Eugenio Suarez went 1-for-4 in a win over the Pirates with a three-run home run and one walk..
impact: Suarez has provided mixed results at the plate, collecting hits in six of his last 12 contests. The veteran remains one of the more frustrating options in a streaky Reds lineup for manager Terry Francona, batting .210 with eight homers, 29 RBI, and 18 runs scored across 54 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Sal Stewart goes deep in win over Pirates
desc: Sal Stewart went 2-for-5 in Saturday's 9-7 win over the Pirates with a home run, a run scored and two RBI.
impact: Stewart continues a productive stretch at the plate, registering hits in five of his last seven contests. The 22-year-old has flashed an explosive bat despite remaining another streaky option in the Reds lineup for manager Terry Francona, slashing .252 with 15 home runs, 57 RBI, 43 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases through 81 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Hao-Yu Lee goes deep in loss to Astros
desc: Hao-Yu Lee went 2-for-4 in a loss to the Astros with a solo home run.
impact: Lee has heated up at the plate, picking up hits in six of his last seven contests. The infielder offers manager AJ Hinch a surprisingly stable option in the Tigers lineup to this point, batting .261 with three homers, 11 RBI, nine runs scored, one stolen base through 45 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Horwitz (hamstring) to be sidelined through All-Star break
desc: Pirates GM Ben Cherington said he expects Spencer Horwitz to be sidelined through the All-Star break.
impact: Horwitz was placed on the injured list earlier this week. He'll likely head on a rehab assignment in the middle of July after he's able to ramp up baseball activities.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Oneil Cruz (hand) to be sidelined through All-Star break
desc: Pirates GM Ben Cherington said he expects Oneil Cruz to be sidelined through the All-Star break in July.
impact: Cruz is expected to head down to Florida this week to ramp up baseball activity. He could begin a rehab assignment in mid-July.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kerry Carpenter cranks grand slam in loss to Astros
desc: Kerry Carpenter went 2-for-4 in a loss to the Astros with a grand slam.
impact: Carpenter has provided mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in five of his last 10 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more streaky bats in an underperforming Tigers lineup, batting .226 with 12 home runs, 35 RBI, and 20 runs scored through 60 games.
